our_interpretation: The surrounding discussion identifies AI data-center projects, including unfinished projects, as the subject.
The ordinary reading is permanent commercial failure before recovering 25% of project costs. A temporary delay, financing default, or change of ownership does not alone establish that outcome.
The projects must already exist or be identifiable as planned projects at the post date. Costs must not be counted twice across owners, lenders, and equipment suppliers.
The speaker supplies neither an accounting basis nor a definition of cost recovery. Both must be resolved before a monetary threshold can receive a decisive score.
criteria.support_condition: Identified eligible projects permanently fail with verified aggregate project costs of at least USD 200 billion, each recovering less than 25% of its costs before failure.
criteria.contradiction_condition: A complete accounting of the eligible project population establishes that projects failing below the recovery threshold total less than USD 200 billion, with every remaining project already recovering at least 25% or otherwise having a final outcome that excludes qualification.
